matt: quick ping — PR #3248 needs one more approval + a tiny style/naming fix (CI is failing on gofumpt + proto json tag). pushed branch `fix/api-names` for the change. can someone eyeball? https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/3248 :pray:
olivia: taking a look now :eyes:
olivia: looks like two things: (1) proto field json names should be snake_case (`user_id`) and (2) gofumpt changed a couple files — CI shows a fmt diff.
sasha: I saw the CI log, the proto change is safe but it touches public API; do we want `user_id` for external JSON?
matt: yes, upstream expects snake_case for JSON. internal code uses `UserID` everywhere, proto json name should be `user_id`. I'll update to that.
judy: quick nit: when you update proto please run the generator script so the pb.go changes are consistent. also add a changelog line since it's a json name change (tiny).
ci-bot: buildkite: redwood/pr/3248 — FAIL — gofumpt diff detected in files: server/api/handlers.go, pkg/model/user.go (run `gofumpt -w` and commit).
matt: good call — running `gofumpt -w` locally and regenerating protos now:
```
# regenerate protos
./scripts/gen_protos.sh && gofumpt -w ./...
```
matt: pushed fix/regen commit (sha abc123) — rerunning CI: https://buildkite.com/redwood/prs/3248/12345
judy: quick review done — pb.go looks good, changelog entry added. left one comment about a test name but not blocking.
sasha: happy to approve once CI is green. @olivia can you give the final code-style ok? :thumbsup:
olivia: LGTM, changes are small and gofumpt cleaned up spacing. approving now. :white_check_mark:
sasha: giving second approval — ready to merge once buildkite finishes and no flakes. :shipit:
ci-bot: buildkite: redwood/pr/3248 — PASS — all steps green.
olivia: merging now to avoid a conflicting churn window — doing a squash+merge.
matt: thanks all, will watch logs. :tada:
